news.headline: Marvell Technology and Penguin Solutions Collaborate on AI Memory Demands
news.summary: Marvell Technology and Penguin Solutions have announced a partnership to integrate Marvell's memory-expansion controllers and optical interconnect technology into Penguin's AI infrastructure systems.

news.headline: Arete Adjusts Price Target on Marvell Technology to $323 From $300
news.summary: Analyst firm Arete has revised its price target for Marvell Technology, Inc. upward to $323 from the previous target of $300.

news.headline: Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC Initiates Investigation into Bloom Energy Corporation
news.summary: Law firm Kahn Swick & Foti, LLC has announced an investigation into the officers and directors of Bloom Energy Corporation regarding potential breaches of fiduciary duty.

news.headline: AMD Shares Decline Following New Export Restrictions on AI Chips
news.summary: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. shares fell 5.58% on November 17, 2026, following the implementation of new export restrictions on advanced AI chips to Southeast Asian countries.

news.headline: AMD-Powered Lux Supercomputer Opens to Scientific Users
news.summary: The Lux supercomputer at Oak Ridge National Laboratory, powered by AMD technology, is now available for scientific research as part of the DOE's Genesis Mission.

news.headline: Graid Technology Announces VROC Support for AMD EPYC Platforms
news.summary: Graid Technology plans to extend its CPU-based NVMe RAID solution to AMD EPYC processor-based systems, with initial support launching in February 2027.
